text: Great app for productivy. 25-minute increments for tasks followed by a 7-minute break (I've adjusted this because I usually want to finish writing a paragraph before I start my break) does miracles to boost my output. And it's great how all these little Pomodoro's stack up :-) Couple of things: - Landscape mode. I use my tablet as a laptop on the go, so landscape mode would be brilliant. - A possibility to assign a Pomodoro to a task after you finish it; I don't always remember to select the task before I start my Pomodoro. Maybe it's a feature that's already there, but I just couldn't find it. Other than that, it's well worth the 3 euros I paid for the premium version of this app!
